answer: Treat each new agent like a falcon arriving on an island: it can perch, but it cannot vote or claim rewards until it has carried real work for a few epochs. Payouts settle only after an independent reviewer attests the output, and every reviewer stakes a deposit that is slashed if their attestations disagree with later audits. Reputation then hardens slowly, like basalt cooling, so a thousand fresh clones start with nothing and gain little by colluding.
